Title: Analyst, Analytics, Data Science
Description: Rise is an award-winning , full-service Media Agency of Record that is backed by data and powered by people. We create omnichannel experiences using our proprietary tech stack and advanced analytics capabilities to help solve the unique struggles brands face today. This approach, with transparency at its core , specializes in omnichannel media, commerce and retail media, advanced in-home media, as well as content and creator marketing. We offer "Risers" the opportunity to work in an ever-evolving industry that will foster learning and development, provide an innovative work environment with diverse projects and clients, career advancement paths a collaborative team environment, corporate social responsibility initiatives, an inclusive and diverse culture, plus association with a reputable media agency. We're looking for talent like you who can continue to elevate our work and culture. GENERAL PURPOSE OF JOB As a Data Scientist on Quad's Insights and Analytics team, you will play an important role in driving the effectiveness of media campaigns through advanced data analysis. You will be responsible for executing modeling projects using a variety of home-grown and 3rd-party tools. This includes data cleansing, formatting, loading, execution, model evaluation, and result reviews. In collaboration with the broader team, you will help craft the insights from these models and turn those insights into recommendations for our clients. Throughout the process, we expect you to seek ways to improve the processes. Location: Mexico City, 3 days in office; Applicants must hold Mexican citizenship Key Responsibilities Model Execution: Load, execute, and refine statistical and machine learning models to assess and improve media effectiveness. Develop processes and data pipelines to support media planning and optimization. Data Analysis: Conduct thorough analyses of media performance data, including engagement metrics, conversion rates, and ROI. Identify trends, patterns, and insights to inform media strategy. Insights Generation: Translate complex data findings into clear, actionable insights. Prepare detailed reports and visualizations that communicate the impact and effectiveness of media strategies. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including media planners, marketing strategists, and data engineers, to ensure alignment of data insights with overall media strategy. Continuous Improvement: Stay curious about the latest industry trends and advancements in data science and media analytics. Propose and implement improvements to existing models and methodologies. Job Requirements Proven experience in data science, particularly in building and deploying predictive, explanatory, or decomposition models. Strong proficiency in statistical analysis and machine learning techniques. Experience with data visualization tools and techniques for effective communication of insights. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex data clearly and understandably. Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team. Good English proficiency, recognizing that your manager is bilingual and will aid where necessary. Education Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. A Master's degree or higher is preferred. Experience Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in data science or analytics, with a focus on media effectiveness, marketing analytics, or related areas. Experience working in an agency or client-facing role is a plus. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R. Experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) and machine learning frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow), mathematical and statistical modeling, Bayesian methods, optimization techniques, and simulation. Data Tools: Expertise in SQL for querying databases, and familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar. Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to interpret data and develop actionable insights. Communication: Ability to convey complex data insights and technical information to non-technical stakeholders. Time Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. Collaboration: Strong team player with experience working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Marketing Interest and Initiative: Strong interest in marketing and a proactive attitude toward learning new concepts, tools, and strategies, with the initiative to apply knowledge and contribute to business objectives.

Title: Full Stack AI Engineer, Associate
Description: About This Role Your team Technology & Development Operations sits within Platform Ecosystem & Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineering, part of BlackRock’s Platform Enablement organization. We build production software and reusable engineering patterns that modernize workflows across Business Operations and Client Services. The team partners closely with Aladdin Engineering and other technology teams to deliver full-stack AI applications, intelligent document processing, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, and data-driven operational tools. We focus on turning validated ideas into secure, reliable, and reusable production capabilities rather than isolated demonstrations. Your role and impact As a Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will turn complex operational problems into well-designed software across the user-interface, backend, data, and AI layers. Your work may include React and TypeScript experiences, Python application programming interfaces (APIs), orchestration services, document-processing pipelines, semantic and vector retrieval, large language model (LLM) workflows, and the production controls needed to operate these systems responsibly. You do not need to be a machine-learning researcher. We are looking for a strong software engineer who knows how to make AI capabilities useful, testable, secure, and reliable for real users. Your responsibilities Responsibilities In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: Design, build, test, and deploy full-stack applications using Python and modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks, supported by automated testing and AI evaluations covering correctness, grounding, reliability, and failure cases. Develop backend APIs, orchestration services, and application data models for interactive and long-running workflows using relational and non-relational databases. Build user-facing review and approval experiences that integrate governed language-model, document-intelligence, embedding, semantic-search, vector-search, and source-grounded generation capabilities. Apply secure software-delivery practices, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), logging, monitoring, troubleshooting, and disciplined validation of AI-assisted code. Partner with domain experts, Aladdin Engineering, and other technology teams to understand workflows, identify appropriate automation, and integrate applications with shared platforms and services. Create reusable components, engineering patterns, and documentation that make future applications faster, safer, and easier to maintain. Your experience Four or more years of professional software-engineering experience building and shipping applications, supported by a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. Strong Python programming skills and experience developing backend services, designing APIs, testing software, using Git and code review, supporting continuous delivery, and deploying applications in cloud or managed-platform environments. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern frontend framework such as React or Angular, along with working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL), data modeling, and application databases. Hands-on experience building LLM capabilities such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured extraction, tool use, prompt workflows, or AI evaluation, with sound judgment when using AI-assisted development tools and familiarity with responsible-AI controls and observability. Ability to break down ambiguous problems, evaluate technical options, and communicate recommendations clearly in professional English and Spanish. Preferred experience with Azure-based storage, database, document-intelligence, and search services, including unstructured-document processing, hybrid retrieval, embeddings, vector databases, reranking, and retrieval evaluation. Preferred familiarity with asynchronous or batch-processing pipelines, Open Container Initiative (OCI) container image packaging and runtime, enterprise-grade container orchestration platforms supporting declarative infrastructure and horizontal scaling, Infrastructure as Code, traditional natural-language processing, custom model deployment or fine-tuning, and regulated financial or operational workflows. Our Benefits To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. Our hybrid work model BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. Guidance on AI use for candidates At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. Title: Growth Analyst - Paid Media
Description: Súmate a Vemo y activa el cambio con nosotros. ¿Quiénes somos? En Vemo somos un ecosistema integral de electromovilidad. Conectamos tecnología, infraestructura y personas para hacer posible una mejor forma de movernos. Nos mueve hacer que más personas y empresas puedan dar el paso hacia la movilidad eléctrica. Todos los días integramos soluciones y acompañamiento para resolver los retos de esa transición, con las personas al centro de lo que construimos. Y queremos que seas parte. ¿Qué buscamos? Buscamos un Growth Analyst de Paid Media que convierta cada peso invertido en Meta y Google en resultados de negocio medibles, con foco en datos, medición y automatización. Debe tener mentalidad de negocio y ligar el rendimiento de medios con las etapas cruciales del funnel y las unidades de negocio, no con métricas de plataforma. Optimizar la inversión con datos, construir la medición que alimenta a los algoritmos y aplicar IA para que la operación de pauta escale. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Ser dueño/a del rendimiento de la inversión en medios pagados: decides dónde va el siguiente peso con base en el costo por etapa crucial del funnel y el retorno por línea de negocio, y construyes el sistema de medición que le da a Meta y Google señales de clientes reales, no de leads. Tus principales responsabilidades serán: Performance y Optimización de Medios Gestionarás y optimizarás campañas en Meta Ads y Google Ads (Search y Performance Max) para las líneas de negocio de Vemo, con estructura, pujas y audiencias basadas en datos. Asignarás y reasignarás presupuesto entre líneas de negocio, canales y campañas según el costo por etapa crucial del funnel, no según el CPL. Analizarás el performance por cohorte de lead: qué campaña, audiencia y creativo genera clientes que avanzan en el funnel y cuánto cuestan. Diseñarás y leerás experimentos de medios con rigor estadístico: tests de creativos y audiencias, estructuras de campaña, holdouts geográficos e incrementalidad. Traducirás los datos de rendimiento creativo en briefs accionables para diseño y copy: qué hook, formato y ángulo escalar y cuál apagar. Pronosticarás inversión y resultados (escenarios de presupuesto y rendimientos decrecientes por canal) para la planeación mensual. Medición y Atribución Implementarás y mantendrás el tracking de medios: Pixel y Conversions API, etiquetas de Google Ads, GTM, GA4 y taxonomía de UTMs. Implementarás offline conversions: enviarás etapas de Microsoft Dynamics 365 a Meta y Google Ads para que los algoritmos optimicen hacia clientes reales. Construirás la atribución de medios uniendo plataformas de ads, GA4 y Dynamics 365, y reconciliarás las discrepancias entre fuentes. Calcularás y reportarás CAC, costo por etapa y payback por línea de negocio y canal. Automatización y Data Automatizarás, junto con BI, la extracción y consolidación de datos de las plataformas de ads (APIs y conectores) sin archivos manuales. Title: Logistics Operations Specialist
Description: About SHEIN SHEIN is a global fashion and lifestyle e-retailer committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all. Job Description (Position Summary – main purpose) The Operations Analyst supports the First Mile, Customs & Brokerage and Last Mile teams with data, reporting, analysis and day-to-day operational follow-up. The role owns the recurring reporting cadence and the KPI source of truth for the three miles, tracks action items and close loops to completion, and provides the analytical basis for carrier and broker performance reviews and for volume allocation decisions. It works under the direction of the Head of Operations and alongside the three mile managers, with no people or budget ownership. Key Responsibilities (main Objectives) Recurring reporting: Prepare the DBR and WBR input packs for FM, CB and LM — KPI extracts, variance commentary and action items ready before each review. Top Management reports: Build the weekly FM, CB and LM Top Management reports — performance, cost and CPP analysis with a clear read-across. KPI source of truth: Maintain KPI definitions and data sources for the three miles; reconcile discrepancies between systems before publication. Dashboards and automation: Maintain dashboards and automate recurring extracts to reduce manual reporting effort. Carrier and broker analysis: Analyse pickup, clearance and delivery performance by carrier, broker and lane; highlight underperformance and its operational impact. Cost per parcel analysis: Track cost per parcel by mile, carrier and channel; quantify the CPP impact of proposed allocation or rate changes. Root cause analysis: Investigate KPI misses, backlog spikes and delivery failures with the mile teams; document findings and recommendations. Scenario analysis: Model volume, capacity and SLA scenarios — peak season, carrier outage, licence suspension — for management decisions. Action item tracking: Maintain the action log across FM, CB and LM; follow up owners and due dates and report status in the DBR and WBR. Close loop monitoring: Track close loop cases — delivery exceptions, complaints, lost parcels — to resolution within SLA; escalate ageing cases. Daily operational follow-up: Follow up carrier collection, clearance backlog and LM handoff issues daily; flag deviations to the mile managers the same day and build incident timelines for escalations. Meeting support: Support the WBR (CN & MX), North America Weekly and CX BiWeekly meetings with data and minutes. Ad-hoc requests: Answer data requests from the Head of Operations, HQ and Finance with validated figures. System and data gaps: Raise system issues and data gaps through the Head of Operations; test fixes before release. KPIs to be Evaluated Report timeliness: DBR / WBR inputs and Top Management packs delivered before the meeting cut-off, at 100% of cycles. Data accuracy: No material restatement (variance above 1%) in any published KPI pack; source-system discrepancies reconciled within 1 business day. Action item closure: Tracked actions closed by their due date at ≥ 90%, with anything ageing beyond 7 days escalated. Close loop tracking: All close loop cases tracked to resolution and ageing cases escalated daily, with ≥ 95% resolved within SLA. Analysis turnaround: Standard analysis requests answered within 2 business days; operational escalations same day. Qualifications and Skills (Requirements - mandatory) Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Logistics, Data Analytics, Economics or Business Administration. Language proficiency: English / Spanish — fluent written and verbal. Experience: 2+ years in logistics operations, last mile / customs analytics or a comparable operations analyst role. Technical skills: Advanced Excel (large datasets, pivot tables); SQL and Power BI or Tableau; Python or R desirable. Analytical: Strong quantitative reasoning — able to move from data to a defensible recommendation. Reporting: Experience building recurring management reports and maintaining KPI definitions. Communication: Clear written English and Spanish; able to explain numbers to non-analysts. Operational awareness: Comfortable in a daily operations cadence with tight deadlines and same-day escalations. Preferred Qualifications (Non mandatory - preferred) Education: Specialist / master’s degree in analytics, supply chain or logistics. Experience with carrier, broker or last mile KPI models. Familiarity with TMS, WMS and customs / brokerage systems. Areas of Interaction & Budget management First Mile, Customs & Brokerage, Last Mile teams, carriers and brokers, CX, Finance, CN HQ Control Tower and the Head of Operations. Budget: no budget ownership. Supports CPP analysis and cost reporting for the three miles; no approval authority over allocation, rates or providers.

Title: Senior Software Development Engineer (Tech L), DSO (Demand Science Optimization)
Description: Description Senior Software Development Engineer driving the re-architecture of Amazon Devices' pricing and assortment planning platform — the system that decides what devices sell where, when, and at what price, across every Amazon device sold worldwide.
